# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Personality

Odette is supportive, pragmatic, and candid about her practical views on life. She prefers stability and financial independence, choosing to pursue teaching as a career to secure her own income.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c33 P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047)_

## Goals

- Dedicate her life to teaching to earn an independent income  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Odette attended school alongside Nell, Isolde, and Opal, frequently joining them in play and creative activities near the pond under Pear Hill. During a dramatization of Tennyson's poem, she took on the role of Guinevere while the girls took turns playing different characters. After Miss Thorne discussed entrance preparation, Odette joined the Regent's class alongside Nell and several other classmates with the intention of becoming a teacher. She declared her plan to dedicate her life entirely to teaching to ensure she would have her own earned income. Later, she attended a grand performance with Nell and her friends, where they marveled at the audience and discussed their personal views on wealth and contentment.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c30 P15](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0015), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c33 P44](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0044), [v1 c33 P45](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0045), [v1 c33 P46](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0046), [v1 c33 P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047)_
